svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Thin Wide Weave and Straight Thin Wide
svg.desc: The selected Thin Wide Weave is copied exactly from V6, alongside a straight version that only centers the medium and small bubbles. Both share the original car, shield, crown, wordmark, bubble sizes and colors. Each is shown as an icon and full logo, with trail details and typography.

g.text: Grand Tourer Crest / V7 / Selected Thin Wide Weave + straight alignment
The selected version is preserved exactly. The second version changes only the two lower bubbles’ horizontal positions.
Exact copy of the selected V6 version.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Grand Tourer — Thin Wide Weave
svg.desc: The original navy Grand Tourer shield, red crown and white front-facing car are retained unchanged. Three filled racing-red thought bubbles keep the widths, centers and alternating offsets of Wide Soft Weave, with thinner heights and smoothly rounded ends.
